Strong enough for research-ready section file with explicit caveats around the 2024 Veddige reroute, stale Stättared-Dranstugan geometry in Naturkartan/OSM/API line.geometry, remote Stättared bus access, Stättared water/toilet normalization, Dranstugan adjacent/legacy facilities, and dynamic fire/protected-area checks.

knownGaps: Only the overview and first four sections have been researched/synthesized; 31 remaining sections still need the six-lane workflow.
Coastal Hallandsleden is incomplete by official statement; future import must model gaps instead of stitching a continuous coast.
Older sources may report 435 km / 26 stages / 3 parts; live official source reports 612 km / 35 sections / 4 subtrails.
Paper maps printed June 2022 are stale for 2024 rerouted sections.
N1: official API line.geometry conflicts with official GPX/API geo_json and should not be used for import.
N1: Fjärås Bräcka shelters/camping need rule clarification before public camping copy.
N1: Stensjön toilet season needs verification before normalization.
N2: official API line.geometry conflicts with official GPX/API geo_json and should not be used for import.
N2: Naturkartan has matching endpoints but a materially different middle alignment; use official GPX/API geo_json as canonical.
N2: OSM relation 3208832 is a legacy/different Stensjön-Äskhult relation, not current N2.
N2: Äskhult shelter fireplace conflicts with Äskhult reserve's general fire prohibition; verify exemption/signage before public fire-use copy.
N2: Äskhult water/toilet should be treated as seasonal or conditional until confirmed otherwise.
N2: Axtorp access distance differs across sources; coordinate-derived straight-line distance is about 1.0-1.1 km, while Länsstyrelsen says 2 km.
N3: official API line.geometry conflicts with official GPX/API geo_json and should not be used for import.
N3: Naturkartan displays 15.0 km while the current official GPX/API geo_json is 17 km; use official GPX/API geo_json as canonical.
N3: official section prose appears to contain stale Stensjön shelter/toilet wording; current N3 places API and endpoint evidence support Lägerplats Stättared instead.
N3: Äskhult/Lilla Äskhult shelter fire and any tenting permission need exact boundary/designated-place verification.
N3: Stättared drinking water is at Stättareds 4H-gård, not the shelter, and all-hours tap access remains unverified.
N3: Stättared bus access is sparse and endpoint distances are measured differently by sources; use Stättaredsvägen/Backen with caveats.
N4: official API line.geometry, Naturkartan full geometry, and OSM relation 3209148 continue toward Dranstugan and should not be used as current N4 geometry.
N4: Dranstugan shelters/water/toilet are official facilities but over 2 km off current N4 GPX; keep as adjacent/legacy context pending N5/side-service modeling.
N4: Stättared water is at Stättareds 4H-gård, not the shelter, and all-hours tap access remains unverified.
N4: Stättared bus access is remote/sparse; Veddige Station is strong endpoint access.
N4: Skoga reserve was screened but not proven on-route; run protected-area polygon overlay before final normalization.
